result.topic_en: A heavily corrected pencil draft of a letter (Gegenbemerkungen, 'counter-remarks') addressed to a 'Herr Doctor', referring to Herr Dr. Borchardt and to a correction of a false formula (S. 6 / S. 126), illustrated by a second-order Taylor expansion of f(s,z) from which a factor 1/2 was omitted; it is written on the back of a Bremen post freight form.
